text:
Maya Ortiz: Heads up — seeing ~87 customers with duplicate credit memos post-nightly sync. Pattern: same Stripe refund id applied twice in NetSuite.
Liam Park: are these duplicates in Stripe or only NetSuite?
Maya Ortiz: Stripe shows single refund id rf_3LxyZ, NetSuite has CM-9012 and CM-9013 for the same external_ref.
Kara (eng): any infra changes today?
DeployBot: deploy complete: release/2026-03-23-09:12 by @Kara
Kara (eng): we pushed a change to the API gateway to normalize incoming headers for a vendor compatibility fix. Might be related.
Liam Park: hmac verification is case-sensitive in our webhook consumer. If gateway lowercased the signature header name, verifier might have rejected the original and triggered our replay flow.
Maya Ortiz: logs show verify failure then replay: 
```
WARN billing:webhook - signature missing for evt_3LxyZ
INFO billing:replay - enqueued evt_3LxyZ for replay attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit memo CM-9012 for refund rf_3LxyZ
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit memo CM-9013 for refund rf_3LxyZ (replayed)
```
Kara (eng): our replay path uses an idempotency key derived from the full raw request (including headers). Because gateway mutated headers, the replay produced a different idempotency key and reprocessed.
Liam Park: root cause = gateway header normalization + idempotency including non-deterministic header fields. Fixes: 1) make signature header lookup case-insensitive, 2) compute idempotency from stable identifiers (stripe_event_id + refund_id), 3) update gateway to preserve signature header untouched for /webhooks routes.
Maya Ortiz: remediation for customers: can we auto-void the second credit memo where external_ref matches and amounts match? We ran into about 87 affected accounts.
Kara (eng): yes, write a backfill: find NetSuite credit memos created within 10m of each other, same refund id, void the later one and attach audit note "auto-void dup from webhook replay". We'll add a dry-run first.
Maya Ortiz: approvals needed for automated voids up to 100 accounts. @finance-approvals please review.
ops-bot: ticket FIN-5018 created: "Gateway header lowercase + idempotency mismatch -> duplicate NetSuite credit memos" assigned to Kara, priority P1.
Liam Park: deploying patch to webhook verifier to perform case-insensitive header lookup and to the idempotency library to use deterministic keys. Adding unit tests for header-case and replay scenarios.
Kara (eng): rolled gateway rollback to preserve header names at 1717956120, monitoring.
Maya Ortiz: approved to proceed with backfill for up to 100 accounts once Kara confirms gateway stable and Liam's patch is merged. Please post results.
billing-bot: Backfill scheduled: 1717957921 (dry-run) — will post output to #finance-updates.
Maya Ortiz: thanks all. We'll coordinate outreach if customers see corrected refunds. :thumbsup:
